questions.question:

2. MYSTICAL

3. MYTHOLOGY

4. MYSTERIOUS

questions.solution:
The correct Dictionary order is:

4. MY__**STERI**__OUS

1. MY__**STERY**__

2. MY__**STI**__CAL

5. MY__**THI**__CAL

So, the correct order is: '**4, 1, 2, 5, 3**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement I:** No bridge is a mountain.

**Statement II:** Some mountains are monuments.

**Statement III:** All monuments are harbours.

**Conclusion I:** Some harbours are mountains.

**Conclusion II:** No bridge is a monument.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b52aec4840c81d9e0235195455e9fbcf6b9b2a2bc2e910cc38f85d5d17566b1.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some harbours are mountains → Follow (As some mountains are monuments and all monuments are harbours. As whole monuments comes in harbours and has some part common with mountains, therefore it is true.)

II. No bridge is a monument → Does not follow (As no bridge is a mountain and some mountains are monuments. As no direct relation is given between bridge and monuments, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Seven friends M, N, O, P, Q, R, and S are sitting around a circular table facing towards the center. S and O are not sitting next to each other. R sits to the immediate left of M. M sits second to the left of S. Q is sitting between N and O. N is a neighbor of S. Who is sitting to the immediate left of N?
questions.solution:
**Given: **Seven friends M, N, O, P, Q, R, and S are sitting around a circular table facing towards the center. 

1) R sits to the immediate left of M.

2) M sits second to the left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29e138ca5f5611d585a7072bd7ec3bfce1e5ffcbb945da44d8ed8139628d1441.png] 

3) N is a neighbor of S.

4) Q is sitting between N and O.

5) S and O are not sitting next to each other.

Thus, after positioning N, O, and Q only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe02ae618b62e32ae96b83859e04071e43d81dd5d24debbf3ae4855655f173f9.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement S is sitting to the immediate left of N.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
